## 1.2 Data wrangling

```{r wrangling_data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Food Data (n=424) ----
food_data <- ffq_data |>
  dplyr::select(contains(c("participant_id", "food_insecurity", "total"))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(-c(participant_id, food_insecurity), as.numeric)) |> 
  ## dropping partiicpants who weren't asked about food insecurity (preliminary FFQ)
  filter(!is.na(food_insecurity)) |> 
  mutate(participant_id = ifelse(participant_id == "NDF7038", "NSF7038", participant_id),
         participant_id = ifelse(participant_id == "NSF705", "NSF7025", participant_id))



## Long Survey Health Data (n=273)----
long_survey_health_data <- long_survey_data |>
  dplyr::select(c(participant_id, gender, age, systolic_1, diastolic_1, systolic_2, diastolic_2,
                  systolic_3, diastolic_3, height, weight, body_fat)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("systolic"), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("diastolic"), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("height"), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("weight"), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(age = as.numeric(age)) |>
  mutate(body_fat = as.numeric(body_fat)) |> 
  mutate(average_systolic  = (systolic_1 + systolic_2 + systolic_3) / 3) |>
  mutate(average_diastolic = (diastolic_1 + diastolic_2 + diastolic_3) / 3) |>
  mutate(MAP = average_diastolic + (average_systolic - average_diastolic) / 3) |>
  mutate(BMI = weight / (height)^2) |> 
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(BMI < 10|BMI > 60, NA, BMI))

## Long Survey SOL Data (confirmed no NAs) (n = 273)----
long_survey_sol_data <- long_survey_data |>
  mutate(material_wall_index = 0) |>  # bamboo, rafia, travelers_palm default to 0
  mutate(material_wall_index = if_else(material_wall == "wood",          1, material_wall_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_wall_index = if_else(material_wall == "burnt_brick",   2, material_wall_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_wall_index = if_else(material_wall == "metal_sheets",  3, material_wall_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_wall_index = if_else(material_wall == "cement",        4, material_wall_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_roof_index = 0) %>%  # bamboo, thatch default to 0
  mutate(material_roof_index = if_else(material_roof == "metal_sheets",  1, material_roof_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_roof_index = if_else(material_roof == "cement",        2, material_roof_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_floor_index = 0) %>%  # bamboo, dirt, travelers_palm default to 0
  mutate(material_floor_index = if_else(material_floor == "wood",   1, material_floor_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_floor_index = if_else(material_floor == "cement", 2, material_floor_index)) %>%
  mutate(cgsol = rowSums(across(c(durable_goods_owned_mobile_phone,
                                   durable_goods_owned_radio,
                                   durable_goods_owned_television,
                                   durable_goods_owned_computer,
                                   durable_goods_owned_refrigerator,
                                   durable_goods_owned_generator,
                                   durable_goods_owned_bicycle,
                                   durable_goods_owned_motorcycle,
                                   durable_goods_owned_car_truck,
                                   durable_goods_owned_boat),
                                as.numeric),
                         na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  select(participant_id, cgsol, material_floor_index, material_wall_index,
         material_roof_index, waist_circumference)

## Cardiochek Data (n=393)----
cardiochek_data <- cardiochek_data |>
  ## dropping duplicate NSF7022 response....age doesn't match for R_mRIUzcXckCQEhdG
  filter(responseid!="R_mRIUzcXckCQEhdG") |> 
  select(-c(survey_date, responseid, age, gender, consent)) |>
  select(-contains("category"))   |> 
  ## removing non-fasting samples
  filter(!grepl("eat", notes))

## CRP Data (n = 133) -----
crp_data <- crp_data |> 
  mutate(cv = as.numeric(cv),
         concentration_pg_ml_raw = as.numeric(concentration_pg_ml_raw),
         additional_dilution_factor = as.numeric(dilution),
         eluate_dilution = 167) |> 
  filter(cv<12,concentration_pg_ml_raw > 18.75,concentration_pg_ml_raw < 1200) |> 
  filter(!grepl("Control|Standard|Blank|Pool", sample_id),
         !(grepl("saturated", notes)),
         assay_number != 2) |> 
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() |> 
  rename(participant_id = sample_id) |> 
  select(participant_id, additional_dilution_factor, concentration_pg_ml_raw) |> 
  filter(!is.na(concentration_pg_ml_raw)) |> 
  mutate(concentration_pg_ml_adjusted_for_dilutions = concentration_pg_ml_raw*additional_dilution_factor) |> 
  mutate(serum_equivalent_mg_L = 1E-6*((355.67*concentration_pg_ml_adjusted_for_dilutions)-59884.10))

## Actigraphy Summary (person-level) (n=103) ----
actigraphy_summary <- actigraphy_data |>
  mutate(
    light_min      = dur_day_total_LIG_min,
    moderate_min   = dur_day_total_MOD_min,
    vigorous_min   = dur_day_total_VIG_min,
    inactivity_min = dur_day_total_IN_min,
    ENMO           = ACC_day_mg,
    intensity_gradient = ig_day_gradient
  ) |>
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  summarise(
    mean_light_min    = mean(light_min,      na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_moderate_min = mean(moderate_min,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_vigorous_min = mean(vigorous_min,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_inactive_min = mean(inactivity_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ENMO         = mean(ENMO,           na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_IG           = mean(intensity_gradient, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid_days      = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### PREPARING DATA FOR CENSORED IMPUTATION----
```{r}
full_dataset <- full_dataset |>
  mutate(
    ldl_cens = case_when(
      !is.na(ldl_cholesterol) ~ "none",
      is.na(ldl_cholesterol)  ~ "interval",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
   ldl_ub = case_when(
      ldl_cens == "none" ~ ldl_cholesterol,
  
        ## LDL not calculated if total cholesterol <100 and/or bf(triglycerides < 50 and/or HDL <20
        ## and/or triglycerides >400
      # TC observed, HDL observed, trig observed (>400 case) -- just plugging in observed values
      ldl_cens == "interval" & !is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) & !is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(total_cholesterol - hdl_cholesterol - (triglycerides / 5), 1),

      # TC observed, HDL observed, trig missing (<50 case) -- use trig's own ub=50
      ldl_cens == "interval" & !is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) &  is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(total_cholesterol - hdl_cholesterol - (50 / 5), 1),

      # TC <100, HDL observed, trig observed -- fall back to TC LLOQ
      ldl_cens == "interval" &  is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) & !is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(100 - hdl_cholesterol - (triglycerides / 5), 1),

      # TC <100, HDL observed, trig <50 -- both substituted to LLOQ
      ldl_cens == "interval" &  is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) &  is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(100 - hdl_cholesterol - (50 / 5), 1),

      # TC < 100, HDL  < 20, triglycerides observed 
      ldl_cens == "interval" &  is.na(hdl_cholesterol) &  is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(100 - 1 - (triglycerides/5), 1),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    ldl_lb = case_when(
      ldl_cens == "none"     ~ ldl_cholesterol,
      ldl_cens == "interval" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    ## Triglycerides (LLOQ = 50)
    tri_cens = case_when(
      !is.na(triglycerides) ~ "none",
      is.na(triglycerides)  ~ "interval",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    tri_lb = case_when(
      tri_cens == "none"     ~ triglycerides,
      tri_cens == "interval" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    tri_ub = case_when(
      tri_cens == "none"     ~ triglycerides,
      tri_cens == "interval" ~ 50,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    ## Total cholesterol (LLOQ = 100)
    tot_chol_cens = case_when(
      !is.na(total_cholesterol) ~ "none",
      is.na(total_cholesterol)  ~ "interval",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    tot_chol_lb = case_when(
      tot_chol_cens == "none"     ~ total_cholesterol,
      tot_chol_cens == "interval" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    tot_chol_ub = case_when(
      tot_chol_cens == "none"     ~ total_cholesterol,
      tot_chol_cens == "interval" ~ 100,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    ## HDL cholesterol (LLOQ = 20)
    hdl_cens = case_when(
      !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) ~ "none",
      is.na(hdl_cholesterol)  ~ "interval",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    hdl_lb = case_when(
      hdl_cens == "none"     ~ hdl_cholesterol,
      hdl_cens == "interval" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    hdl_ub = case_when(
      hdl_cens == "none"     ~ hdl_cholesterol,
      hdl_cens == "interval" ~ 20,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
  
```

## 1.5 Analytic dataset

```{r model_data}

model_data <- full_dataset |>
  filter(!is.na(mean_ENMO)) |> # only want actigraphy participants pre-scaling
  mutate(
    cgsol_z = as.numeric(scale(cgsol)),   # substantive MI predictor: consumer goods
    hsol_z  = as.numeric(scale(hsol))) |>      # control variable: housing quality
  mutate(
    log_BMI           = log(BMI),
    log_body_fat      = log(body_fat),
    market_food_index_raw = market_food_index,
    market_food_index = log(market_food_index + 1),
    log_MAP           = log(MAP),
    log_glucose       = log(glucose),
    log_hdl           = log(hdl_cholesterol),
    log_total_cholesterol = log(total_cholesterol),
    log_triglycerides = log(triglycerides),
    log_ldl           = log(ldl_cholesterol),
    log_crp           = log(crp),
    age_raw           = age,

    ## interval censored triglycerides, HDL, total cholesterol, and LDL
    ## NOTE: these are scaled manually below using a SHARED mean/sd per analyte,
    ## NOT via the generic across()/scale() block -- scaling lb/ub independently
    ## would not preserve lb < ub ordering, since each column would get a
    ## different mean/sd applied to it.
    log_ldl_lb = log(ldl_lb),
    log_ldl_ub = log(ldl_ub),

    log_tri_lb = log(tri_lb),
    log_tri_ub = log(tri_ub),

    log_tot_chol_lb = log(tot_chol_lb),
    log_tot_chol_ub = log(tot_chol_ub),

    log_hdl_lb = log(hdl_lb),
    log_hdl_ub = log(hdl_ub)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(c(market_food_index,
                  log_BMI,
                  log_body_fat,
                  log_MAP,
                  log_glucose,
                  log_crp,
                  log_hdl,
                  log_total_cholesterol,
                  log_ldl,
                  log_triglycerides,
                  age),
                ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) |>
  mutate(
    gender          = case_when(
      gender == "Male"   ~ 1L,
      gender == "Female" ~ 0L,
      TRUE               ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    food_insecurity = as.integer(food_insecurity),
    village         = as.character(village)
  )


scale_censored_pair <- function(data, lb_col, ub_col, cens_col, raw_observed_col) {
  log_mean <- data |>
    filter(.data[[cens_col]] == "none") |>
    mutate(tmp = log(.data[[raw_observed_col]])) |>
    pull(tmp) |>
    mean(na.rm = TRUE)

  log_sd <- data |>
    filter(.data[[cens_col]] == "none") |>
    mutate(tmp = log(.data[[raw_observed_col]])) |>
    pull(tmp) |>
    sd(na.rm = TRUE)

  new_lb_name <- paste0("log_", lb_col)
  new_ub_name <- paste0("log_", ub_col)

  data |>
    mutate(
      "{new_lb_name}" := (log(.data[[lb_col]]) - log_mean) / log_sd,
      "{new_ub_name}" := (log(.data[[ub_col]]) - log_mean) / log_sd
    )
}

model_data <- model_data |>
  scale_censored_pair("ldl_lb", "ldl_ub", "ldl_cens", "ldl_cholesterol") |>
  scale_censored_pair("tri_lb", "tri_ub", "tri_cens", "triglycerides") |>
  scale_censored_pair("hdl_lb", "hdl_ub", "hdl_cens", "hdl_cholesterol") |>
  scale_censored_pair("tot_chol_lb", "tot_chol_ub", "tot_chol_cens", "total_cholesterol")

## Ensuring none of the duplicate participants ended up in the model df
exclusive_id_pairs <- list(
  c("A123", "A414"),
  c("A175", "A387"),
  c("A181", "A360"),
  c("A188", "A382"),
  c("A222", "A307")
)

for (pair in exclusive_id_pairs) {
  in_data <- pair %in% model_data$participant_id
  if (all(in_data)) {
    cat("VIOLATION:", pair[1], "and", pair[2], "both present\n")
  } else if (!any(in_data)) {
    cat("neither present:", pair[1], "/", pair[2], "\n")
  } else {
    cat("OK - exactly one present:", pair[which(in_data)], "\n")
  }
}

# Missingness summary
model_data |>

    n_gender_missing = sum(is.na(gender)),
    n_hsol_missing = sum(is.na(hsol_z)),
    n_cgsol_missing = sum(is.na(cgsol_z)))
```

```{r demo_table}
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
```

# 4. Exploratory Analyses of Physical Activity

## 4.1 Preparing data

```{r actigraphy_subsample, cache = TRUE}
model_data_acti <- model_data |>
  ## cutting out likely infected CRP samples
  mutate(log_crp = ifelse(crp>10, NA, log_crp)) |> 
  mutate(log_waist_circumference = scale(log(waist_circumference))) |> 
  mutate(mean_light_min_z = scale(mean_light_min),
         mean_moderate_min_z = scale(mean_moderate_min),
         mean_vigorous_min_sqrt_z = scale(sqrt(mean_vigorous_min)),
         mean_inactive_min_z = scale(mean_inactive_min),
         mean_ENMO_z = scale(mean_ENMO),
         mean_IG_z = scale(mean_IG)) |> 
  mutate(
    high_total_cholesterol = ifelse(tot_chol_lb >= 200, 1L, 0L),
    high_ldl_cholesterol   = ifelse(ldl_lb >= 100, 1L, 0L),
    high_triglycerides     = ifelse(tri_lb >= 150, 1L, 0L),
    high_glucose           = ifelse(glucose >= 100, 1L, 0L),
    low_hdl_cholesterol    = case_when(
      gender == 1 & hdl_lb < 40 ~ 1L,
      gender == 0 & hdl_lb < 50 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    high_waist_circumference    = case_when(
      gender == 1 & waist_circumference >= 102 ~ 1L,
      gender == 0 & waist_circumference >= 88 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    high_cardiochek_binary = case_when(
      high_total_cholesterol == 1 | high_ldl_cholesterol == 1 |
        high_triglycerides == 1 | high_glucose == 1 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    high_bp_for_mets = ifelse(average_systolic >= 130 | average_diastolic >= 85, 1L, 0L)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metabolic_syndrome_score = rowSums(
      cbind(high_glucose, high_bp_for_mets, high_triglycerides, low_hdl_cholesterol, high_waist_circumference)
    ),
    metabolic_syndrome_binary = ifelse(metabolic_syndrome_score>=3, 1, 0)
  )

model_data_acti |>
  summarise(
    n_total_chol_missing    = sum(is.na(total_cholesterol)),
    n_triglycerides_missing = sum(is.na(triglycerides)),
    n_crp_missing = sum(is.na(log_crp)),
    n_ldl_missing           = sum(is.na(ldl_cholesterol)),
    n_tested                = sum(!is.na(fasted)),
    # overlap: missing both total_chol and triglycerides
    n_both_chol_tri_missing          = sum(is.na(total_cholesterol) & is.na(triglycerides), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## 4.2 Predictors of PA
```{r acti_priors}
priors_path <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = b, coef = "villageMandena"),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept)
)

fit_pa_outcome_model <- function(outcome, data = model_data_acti, seed = 24) {
  form <- bf(as.formula(paste0(outcome, " | weights(n_valid_days) ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + age + gender + village")))
  brm(
    formula = form,
    data    = data,
    family  = gaussian(),
    prior   = priors_path,
    chains  = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, cores = 4, seed = seed
  )
}

pa_outcomes <- c(
  "mean_light_min_z",
  "mean_moderate_min_z",
  "mean_vigorous_min_sqrt_z",
  "mean_inactive_min_z",
  "mean_ENMO_z",
  "mean_IG_z"
)

# fits_pa_outcomes <- purrr::map(pa_outcomes, fit_pa_outcome_model) |>
#   purrr::set_names(pa_outcomes)
# saveRDS(fits_pa_outcomes, file = paste0(fits_dir, "predictors_PA_2026.08.17.rds"))

fits_pa_outcomes<- readRDS(paste0(fits_dir, "/predictors_PA_2026.08.17.rds"))

extract_predictor_effects <- function(fits, predictors = c("gender", "age", "cgsol_z", "hsol_z", "villageMandena")) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(fits, function(fit, outcome_key) {
    fe <- as.data.frame(fixef(fit, probs = c(0.055, 0.945)))
    fe$predictor <- rownames(fe)
    fe |>
      dplyr::filter(predictor %in% predictors) |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        outcome   = outcome_key,
        predictor = predictor,
        estimate  = Estimate,
        lower     = Q5.5,
        upper     = Q94.5
      )
  })
}


fits_pa_outcomes<-fits_pa_outcomes[c("mean_inactive_min_z", "mean_ENMO_z", "mean_IG_z")]

predictor_effects <- extract_predictor_effects(fits_pa_outcomes)


outcome_pa_labels <- c(
  mean_inactive_min_z      = "Inactivity",
  mean_ENMO_z              = "ENMO",
  mean_IG_z                = "Intensity Gradient"
)

pa_colors <- c(
  "Inactivity"         = "#313695",  
  "ENMO"                = "#4d4d4d",  
  "Intensity Gradient"  = "#984ea3"  
)

predictor_labels <- c(
  gender  = "Sex [Male]",
  age     = "Age",
  cgsol_z = "Commercial goods",
  hsol_z  = "Household materials",
  villageMandena = "Village [Mandena]"
)

predictor_effects <- predictor_effects |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    outcome_label = factor(outcome_pa_labels[outcome],
                            levels = rev(outcome_pa_labels)),  # try this if dodge order comes out flipped
    predictor_label = factor(predictor_labels[predictor], levels = rev(predictor_labels))
  )



ggplot(predictor_effects, aes(y = predictor_label, x = estimate, color = outcome_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), height = 0,
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pa_colors) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "Posterior estimate (89% CI)", y = NULL, color = "PA outcome") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black" ))

ggsave("predictors_of_pa.png", path = "/Users/levkolinski/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/EEID_Data_public/manuscripts/cardiometabolic_health_food_security/Figures/",
       units="in", width=10, height=7, dpi=350, device = "jpeg", bg = "white")
```

Not controlling for cgsol (activate market participation) because we want total effects of PA on health
```{r}

##  A324 does not have cardiochek data
model_data_acti<-model_data_acti |> 
  mutate(log_ldl_lb = ifelse(participant_id == "A324", NA, log_ldl_lb),
         ldl_cens = ifelse(participant_id == "A324", NA, ldl_cens),
         log_tri_lb = ifelse(participant_id == "A324", NA, log_tri_lb),
         log_tri_ub = ifelse(participant_id == "A324", NA, log_tri_ub),
         tri_cens = ifelse(participant_id == "A324", NA, tri_cens),
         log_hdl_lb = ifelse(participant_id == "A324", NA, log_hdl_lb),
         log_hdl_ub = ifelse(participant_id == "A324", NA, log_hdl_ub),
         hdl_cens = ifelse(participant_id == "A324", NA, hdl_cens))


pa_exposures <- c(
  "mean_light_min_z",
  "mean_moderate_min_z",
  "mean_vigorous_min_sqrt_z",
  "mean_inactive_min_z",
  "mean_ENMO_z",
  "mean_IG_z"
)

outcome_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~model_name,      ~lhs,                                              ~family,
  "MAP",            "log_MAP",                                        gaussian(),
  "CRP",            "log_crp",                                        gaussian(),
  "body_fat",       "log_body_fat",                                   gaussian(),
  "waist_circ",     "log_waist_circumference",                        gaussian(),
  "bmi",            "log_BMI",                                        gaussian(),
  "glucose",        "log_glucose",                                    gaussian(),
  "triglycerides",  "log_tri_lb | cens(tri_cens, y2 = log_tri_ub)",    gaussian(),
  "ldl",            "log_ldl_lb | cens(ldl_cens, y2 = log_ldl_ub)",    gaussian(),
  "hdl",            "log_hdl_lb | cens(hdl_cens, y2 = log_hdl_ub)",    gaussian(),
  "met_s",          "metabolic_syndrome_binary",                      bernoulli(link = "logit")
)


fit_health_outcome_model <- function(lhs, exposure, family = gaussian(), data = model_data_acti, seed = 24) {
  form <- bf(as.formula(paste0(lhs, " ~ ", exposure, " + hsol_z + age + gender + village")))
  brm(
    formula = form,
    data    = data,
    family  = family,
    prior   = c(prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b),
                prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = b, coef = "villageMandena"),
                prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept)),
    chains  = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, cores = 4, seed = seed
  )
}

fit_health_outcome_models <- function(exposure, specs = outcome_specs, seed = 24) {
  specs |>
    purrr::pmap(\(model_name, lhs, family) fit_health_outcome_model(lhs, exposure, family, seed = seed)) |>
    purrr::set_names(specs$model_name)
}

extract_pa_effect <- function(fits, exposure_var, exposure_label) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(fits, function(fit, outcome_key) {
    fe  <- fixef(fit, probs = c(0.055, 0.945))
    row <- fe[exposure_var, ]
    tibble::tibble(
      outcome  = outcome_key,
      exposure = exposure_label,
      estimate = row[["Estimate"]],
      lower    = row[[3]],
      upper    = row[[4]]
    )
  })
}
```
